text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I notice Mejiro Bright going
out of her
way to hide her forehead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, a small pimple has appeared, you
see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've been eating right and maintaining a
proper
daily routine of late, so I wonder
how this has
happened.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Setting that aside for the moment,
though, I've
come to share something
scrumptious with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Here you are... These macarons are from
a cute
little sweet shop that's been in
business for
generations. I hope you like
them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
They're crunchy to start but soft on the
inside,
and pair perfectly with tea. Truth
be told, I have
to be careful not to eat
too many! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the sweets are what caused her
flare-up?
Either way, it looks like Mejiro
Bright's pimple is
bothering her...
